description: This Java class defines the ConceptName entity used within the OpenMRS healthcare software system. It models a concept's name, including properties like locale, type, creator, voided status, and associated tags. It provides methods for managing these properties, checking attributes like preference and type, and handling tags.

classes.name: ConceptName
classes.description: Represents a localized name of a concept within the OpenMRS health record system, including metadata such as locale, type, creator, and voided status, along with methods to manage these attributes.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the concept. If the name is blank and the concept name type is SHORT, the ConceptName is marked as voided.

methods.name: addTag
methods.description: Adds a tag to this ConceptName with an optional description.

methods.name: hasTag
methods.description: Checks if this ConceptName has a specific tag, by tag object or string.
